items.title: Satya Nadella Says “the Floor of Cyber Attacks Has Fallen.” Microsoft Just Declared Code Red After a 24-Hour Outage
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft declared a code red after a 24-hour outage hit Outlook, Teams and Copilot, and it wants to fix future global problems within an hour. Satya Nadella says AI has made cyberattacks easier and fixes must go live instantly, making reliability an ongoing cost.
